title: Coronagraph Watch
text:
🔭 Coronagraph Watch — November 19, 2026

Today’s elevated solar activity makes the outer corona worth a look.

🔥 Strongest recent flare: M2.4

We're watching the corona today!

Several active regions and sunspot groups are visible across the Sun today, making for a moderately active disk.

Image: NOAA SWPC — CCOR-2
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
